gbifID.description: Global Biodiversity Information Facility unique record identifier for each occurrence entry.

datasetKey.description: Uniform dataset identifier as a UUID string, identical for all occurrence records.

occurrenceID.description: Unique observation URLs linking to iNaturalist records for each sighting.

kingdom.description: Taxonomic kingdom classification for the species, consistently recorded as Plantae.

phylum.description: Taxonomic phylum classification for each record, consistently Tracheophyta.

class.description: Taxonomic class of the species, Liliopsida.

order.description: Taxonomic order of the species, consistently Poales for all records.

family.description: Plant family classification, consistently Poaceae across all records.

genus.description: Taxonomic genus for all records, consistently Alopecurus.

species.description: Taxonomic identifier for the recorded grass, always Alopecurus myosuroides.

infraspecificEpithet.description: Infraspecific epithet data is entirely missing from all records.

taxonRank.description: Taxonomic rank is species for all records.

scientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded species, Alopecurus myosuroides Huds.

verbatimScientificName.description: Scientific name of the recorded species, consistently Alopecurus myosuroides.

verbatimScientificNameAuthorship.description: Scientific name authorship information is unavailable for all records.

countryCode.description: Country code identifies the ISO‑3166‑1 alpha‑2 code of the recording location.

locality.description: Locality information is missing for all records.

occurrenceStatus.description: All records denote presence of the species at each observation site.

individualCount.description: Individual count data is missing for all records.

publishingOrgKey.description: Identifier of the organization that published the occurrence record.

decimalLatitude.description: Geographic latitude in decimal degrees for each occurrence record.

decimalLongitude.description: Geographic longitude of the observation expressed in decimal degrees.

coordinateUncertaintyInMeters.description: Spatial uncertainty of occurrence coordinates, expressed in meters.

coordinatePrecision.description: Coordinate precision is missing for every occurrence record.

elevation.description: Elevation data is unavailable for all records.

elevationAccuracy.description: Elevation accuracy measurement is unavailable for all records.

depth.description: Depth information is unavailable for all records.

depthAccuracy.description: Depth accuracy data is unavailable for all records.

eventDate.description: Observation date and time of each record.

day.description: Observation day of month when the record was collected.

taxonKey.description: Taxonomic identifier for Alopecurus myosuroides records.

speciesKey.description: Uniform species identifier for Alopecurus myosuroides across all records.

basisOfRecord.description: Record source type, indicating observations made by humans.

institutionCode.description: Data source identifier for all records, consistently “iNaturalist”.

collectionCode.description: All records are classified under the collection code “Observations”.

catalogNumber.description: Unique numeric identifier assigned to each Alopecurus myosuroides occurrence record.

recordNumber.description: All entries are missing; no data recorded for this field.

identifiedBy.description: Names of individuals who recorded the species occurrence.

dateIdentified.description: Timestamp of when each Alopecurus myosuroides occurrence was recorded, ranging from 2015 to 2026.

license.description: License type for dataset usage, using Creative Commons variants.

rightsHolder.description: Names of individuals or organizations holding copyright for each occurrence record.

recordedBy.description: Observer names who documented each Alopecurus myosuroides occurrence record.

typeStatus.description: No data recorded for this field.

establishmentMeans.description: Establishment means field is entirely missing across all records.

lastInterpreted.description: Date and time when the record was last interpreted.

mediaType.description: Media type of associated record, indicating format such as still image.

issue.description: Data quality flags indicating coordinate rounding, continent derivation, and missing taxon identifiers.

alopecurus_myosuroides.description: Alopecurus myosuroides occurrence records (2007‑2026) with taxonomy, location, date, observer and licensing metadata.

description: Records of Alopecurus myosuroides occurrences from 2007 to 2026 for biodiversity monitoring.
